purpose: Decorative cyberpunk RPG city world for the optional project journal skin; not a product screenshot or shipped game
prompt: Create an original immersive pixel-art cyberpunk RPG world scene for a personal software project website. This is environment concept art, NOT a webpage mockup. Wide panoramic composition approximately 2:1. A richly layered rainy neon city at blue hour/night: foreground rooftop walkway or quiet narrow street, luminous little workshops and a vending kiosk, overhead cables, distant dense futuristic towers and elevated transit disappearing into volumetric indigo mist. Wet pavement reflects cyan, magenta, electric violet and a few amber lights. A tiny anonymous backpacked traveller near the lower right gives the feeling of entering an RPG world, not the main subject. Strong storytelling and real depth: foreground architectural silhouettes at far edges, middle-ground street and rooftops, distant hazy skyline. Sophisticated restricted palette with deep navy/plum shadows, teal glow and selective coral/pink highlights, warm welcoming pockets of light. Authentic beautifully art-directed 16-bit/pixel RPG environment: deliberate visible square pixels, stepped edges, precise clusters, limited dither, no smoothing, no photorealism, no painterly brushstrokes, no 3D. Compose the LEFT upper and middle 55 percent as dark quieter architectural sky/background with enough calm contrast for overlaid cream typography, while the RIGHT half has the brightest city details and sense of distance; keep details throughout so it feels like a whole world, not an empty gradient. Bottom dark foreground should naturally support a gentle fade into a deep navy website. No typography, no readable words, no letters, no logos, no watermarks, no UI frames, no borders, no screenshots. Any signs are abstract lights or simple pictograms. Do not imitate a specific game or existing artwork. This should feel like arriving in a lively cyberpunk RPG town, atmospheric and immersive rather than a generic science-fiction wallpaper.
